facts.claim: Subscription apps typically recover acquisition cost in 60 to 90 days
facts.excerpt: For subscription apps the typical CAC payback period is 60-90 days, depending on plan length, trial conversion rate and pricing.

facts.claim: Monthly plans retain about 65% at day 30, 43% at day 90 and 17% at one year
facts.excerpt: For monthly plans, day 30 retention is approximately 65%, day 90 approximately 43%, and one-year approximately 17%.

facts.claim: Median growth for companies between 1 million and 30 million dollars ARR is 26%, with top performers at 40% to 50%
facts.source_title: Rule of 40 in SaaS: 2026 Data, Benchmarks and Valuation Impact
facts.excerpt: For companies in the $1M-$30M ARR range, median growth is 26%, while top performers grow at 40-50%.

facts.claim: The median Rule of 40 score was 25% in 2025, and the measure only starts to bite from about 20 million dollars ARR
facts.source_title: Rule of 40 in SaaS: 2026 Data, Benchmarks and Valuation Impact
facts.excerpt: The 2025 median Rule of 40 score is 25%. The Rule of 40 becomes a meaningful benchmark at roughly $20M ARR and above.

facts.claim: The RBI E-Mandate Framework 2026 allows recurring debits up to 15,000 rupees without additional authentication, and up to 1,00,000 rupees for insurance, mutual funds and credit-card bills
facts.source_title: UPI Autopay and Recurring Payments: Compliance Checklist Under RBI's E-Mandate Framework 2026
facts.excerpt: Recurring transactions up to Rs 15,000 process without additional factor authentication after setup; insurance, mutual funds and card bills up to Rs 1,00,000.

facts.claim: India's median cost per install fell from 0.71 dollars in July 2025 to 0.42 dollars in June 2026
facts.source_title: Cost per install benchmarks by country, platform and category
facts.excerpt: India's median CPI averaged about $1.18 per install, starting at $0.71 in July 2025 and finishing at $0.42 in June 2026.
